# Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

Everyone is welcome here, regardless of background, identity or experience.

## Expected behaviour

Be respectful and direct. Critique code, not people. Accept that maintainers decide what
fits the project, and that forking is a legitimate answer when it does not.

## Unacceptable behaviour

Harassment, personal attacks, discriminatory language, publishing private information,
and deliberate disruption.

## Enforcement

Report violations privately to the maintainer via
[GitHub](https://github.com/tn3w). Reports are handled confidentially.
Maintainers may edit, remove or reject contributions and may ban accounts that break
these rules.

Adapted from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org), v2.1.
